name: Light Teal
lede: Light Teal is a pale green recorded in Wikipedia's color lists and the 2010 xkcd survey, with nine near-duplicate names clustered in one ISCC-NBS block.

sections.title: A light build of teal
sections.body:
Our Color Graph gives Light Teal, #90E4C1, as modifier grammar: light plus the base name [[teal]], carried by Wikipedia's color lists and the xkcd survey of 2010 [1]. The ISCC-NBS system classes the hue as very light green, only 1.7 units from that block's center, the closest fit in this group [1]. Its Munsell notation is 7.1G 8.4/5.6 and its LCH values are lightness 85, chroma 34, hue 165 degrees [1]. The nearest common library name is [[mint]], 3.6 units away [2].

Nine ISCC-NBS block names cluster around this swatch, among them Aline Green, Ice Green, Icy Morn, Island Green, Jealousy and La Mer [2]. That is the largest such cluster, all filed under one ISCC-NBS block from 1955 [2]. See [[teal]] for the darker, bluer color this name lightens.

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Within CIEDE2000 4, our within-painting lens finds no match for Light Teal in the 23,781-painting archive, though the broader whole-painting lens finds it once, in an 1825 painting, as photographed [3]. In print, the word rose fastest in the 1990s and peaked in the 2010s, across all its senses, including the plant and the fabric color as well as this exact pale green [3].
